events.title: Bollywood Theme Party
events.description: India has had a great impact on the world and they defo know how to party so it makes perfect sense to have an entire Bollywood themed party. Embracing culture is a great thing to have for an event.. and its even better to decorate it. Lots of colours bright and bold fabrics reds, purples, pinks and golds. Once again draping a room can really have a wonderful effect in transforming a space, alongside lighting and Bollywood dancers to get the guests up and dancing

events.title: Neon Glow Party Theme
events.description:
A wonderfully bright and fun party theme we love to create for our guests.

On entrance everyone can be given a glow sticks. Centrepieces can easily be LED based colour changing items such as globes. Staging options can be colourful with up lighting and production bringing in lots of lighting to make the space exciting.

Why not have a not have illuminated furniture and a cool corridor with lots of lighting to bring in the party.

events.title: Superhero theme
events.description:
This is a great option for birthday parties, bar and bat mitsvah and clients wanting something a but more on the fun side.

The comic superhero theme is a great option through he use of lots of colours superhero props such as large ‘ wham’ and ‘bamb’ words that can be placed around, a custom printed dancefloor in the middle of the room and lots of fun lighting.

We can create custom centrepieces with different nods to superheros of your choosing. Guests can dress up in their favourite superhero’s which there are a lot of – and you can have the best dressed competition to add an element of competition among your guests.

Don’t forget key areas for photo opps since we live in the Instagram world- guests will want to snap photos in their cool outfits. Everything superhero related we would love to help transform the space into something bad-ass!

events.title: Cyber punk theme
events.description:
What is a cyberpunk theme? Well this  a subgenre of science fiction in a dystopian futuristic setting that tends to focus on a “combination of lowlife and high tech”, featuring futuristic technological and scientific achievements, such as artificial intelligence and cyberware – so what does that mean in a party form? Well, it means bright neon colours, entertainment with neon outfits and funky colours.

Table décor that is similar including bold bright centrepieces, disco ball elements and of course colourful flowers.

This theme lends itself to a lot of hired custom dressed waiters, greaters and drinks people. Give them blonde wigs, metallic leotards and large glasses and you’ve got yourself a wicked entrance. We can work alongside the talent to make the event amazing.

events.title: Greek God and Goddess Gala
events.description:
This is a unique theme that does not get done enough- getting guests to come as their favourite Greek gods in towels is not only epic but quite a remarkable- Greek goddess dresses are elegant and ethereal which most guests would love to attend. Décor wise – lots of roman columns and ivy filled candelabras with busts and candles and cascading fruit displays with lots of grapes and lounge areas. This theme works well for weddings and birthday parties where guests feel a bit more comfortable!

Prop wise- large Greek god statues would be a perfect entrance and backdrop for guests to see.

events.title: Disco theme / Studio 54
events.description: Guests can come in bell bottom trousers and afros and the décor can be very dramatic and beautiful will stunning shimmery walls, sparkly hanging chandeliers, colourful or sequin table cloths and centrepieces. This can include disco ball centrepieces. Adding discoball head girls to welcome guests and to get guests up and dancing. Which makes this theme ideal for weddings, birthday parties, galas and summer parties.

events.title: Winter Wonderland Party theme
events.description:
This is one we often do for Christmas parties and celebrations and weddings – so we certainly love this theme. Lots of options for a Christmas party or a winter wonderland party including snow covered trees, apres ski styling, lots of blue lighting for ambiance alongside lots of birch branches to align corridors, white maple trees to create a statement entrance, lots of white draping to cover boring walls and to really produce a transformative effect.

Custom bars with lots of illuminated lighting and fun cocktails. We have lots of beautiful stock for the winter wonder land theme and its ideal for those lovely Christmas parties that want transformative effect for their office, or party.

events.title: Willy Wonka themed parties!!
events.description:
I love sweets and this is an amazing party theme everyone loves colourful events and this is an epic design option that one can do to really transform a space. Carpeting the floor in green carpet and the introduction of lots of giant sweets, candy canes and more. A corridor can be covered in lots of candy styled props to align the entrance way.

Willy Wonka themed parties are a great choice at the moment with the new film coming out. This theme would work well for a summer party, a bar/bat mitzvah and galas. There are some links to the Alice in wonderland theme which can have a nice cross over.

Why not draft in the oompa Loompas to make the event extra authentic.
